purpose: Test whether generic wall-focused regional attention can recover small localized and low-contrast wall defects without supplying the exact ground-truth condition.

evidence_policy.keyframe_rule: Use the same existing selected frame closest to 2.0 seconds.

prompt_policy: Look for small holes, openings, filled fastener holes, unfinished repair patches, rough or uneven repaired areas, patch-edge irregularity, or clearly mismatched finish.
Do not assume any defect exists.
Reject normal wall texture, shadows, lighting variation, clean seams, trim, outlets, reflections, and ordinary paint variation.
Return findings only when the wall-surface condition is distinctly visible.
success_criteria: Produce zero findings on the four clean wall-control clips.
Diagnostic success does not change official development recall.
interpretation: If both positive cases are found and clean controls remain negative, build a full annotation-blind 42B-4A candidate over all eligible zero-issue clips.
If positives are still missed, generic wall-category attention is insufficient and a different regional proposal strategy is needed.
